calculate_mpjpe_metric: calculate the mean per-joint position error of 3D keypoints using the MPJPE class
evaluate_with_procrustes_alignment: evaluate keypoints using p-mpjpe mode with procrustes alignment for scale normalization
evaluate_with_scale_alignment: evaluate keypoints using n-mpjpe mode with scale rotation and translation alignment
process_batch_predictions: process a batch of predicted and ground truth keypoints to compute MPJPE metrics
compute_per_action_metrics: compute MPJPE metrics grouped by action category from processed results
